description: In handle_mailbox_set (mailbox.rs:456-458 and 560-562), the role-uniqueness check searches 'created' (a serde_json::Map<String, Value>) for any entry whose 'role' field matches. This traverses the serialized mailbox objects with Value::get("role") string comparison. If the MailboxRole serialization form changes (e.g. becomes a tagged enum), this check will silently break. A more robust approach is a separate HashSet<String> tracking roles assigned so far in this request (analogous to roles_updated_this_request which already exists for updates). The discrepancy between the two approaches in the same function is a future maintenance footgun.
title: Mailbox/set role uniqueness: searching 'created' JSON map for role is fragile
